title: Prepare a new-unit Plan
responsibility: Checks a creation request’s selected project and runner before returning a context for proposing a new unit.

inputs.name: prepareProjectRun.preparation
inputs.description: The preparation data and services carried into the run context. Its session asserts and loads the requested project, and its provider selector chooses the runner.

inputs.name: prepareProjectRun.request
inputs.description: The requested project run. It must have intent "create" and mode "plan"; its projectId is used for the project assertion, and its provider, model, and effort are passed to runner selection.

examples.text: Create a function that normalizes uploaded project paths.

inputs.name: prepareProjectRun.controller
inputs.description: The cancellation controller for this preparation. Its signal is checked after project and runner preparation, then included in the returned context.

outputs.name: prepareProjectRun
outputs.description: Resolves with the preparation fields, writable project, project root, revision and planning values, a fresh randomUUID() id, the request, selected runner, and controller signal. The helper returns only after project assertion, mutable-project lookup, runner selection, and the final abort check, and writes nothing itself.

errors.name: InvalidProjectRunRequestError
errors.description: Thrown with the message "Something new is asked for as a Plan." when intent is not "create" or mode is not "plan".

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Thrown when the controller signal is aborted after project and runner preparation and before the context is returned.
